title: Avoid repeating unfinished evaluator outcomes in parent cards and compact child previews
outcome: Parent cards show one unfinished-evidence outcome with a short supplementary detail, while the full phase/cause and runtime failure remain in the result/finding; child preview remains bounded.
acceptance: An unfinished evaluator's unavailable and runtime-failure card paths include the outcome once and preserve distinct supplementary runtime detail.
Published result summaries/findings retain the complete bounded infrastructure cause while child previews stay bounded.
Behavioral fixture coverage exercises initial terminal publication and later card refresh without relying on repository Markdown or instruction text.
